name: Hospital Budget Allocation and ROI Optimization
task:
Please complete the following four-stage budget task.

A regional hospital: $4,500,000. Emergency Medicine (35%), Surgery (25%), Pediatrics (20%), Administration (10%), Facilities (10%). Pediatrics needs $150,000 for new neonatal equipment. Each surgical unit minimum $600,000.

Calculate NPV for each proposed project.

Reallocate within budget caps.

Compare allocation strategies.
